name: Sala
source:
Sala is the abandoned android that Hiroki takes home, she doesn’t know much about the world and acts a bit like a small child. She really likes Hiroki and wants him to become her master. Until then she tries to copy [url=/c1762]Alicia’s[/url] example and do her best for Hiroki.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/01/otome-kairo-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
